# Measuring product-market fit with a survey | Alex Fixture

## Transcript

Lenny (00:00:05):
How did you know when you had product-market fit?

Alex Fixture (00:00:12):
We ran a product-market fit survey. We asked users how they would feel if they could no longer use the product. When more than forty percent answered very disappointed, we knew retention would hold.

(00:01:30):
The second step was segmenting the very disappointed users and building the roadmap for them. Product-market fit is a number you can move every quarter.

Lenny (00:02:10):
What would you tell a seed-stage founder?

Alex Fixture (00:02:20):
Measure product-market fit early, talk to the users who love you, and ignore the ones who would not miss you.
